svg.text: Low-level design: citizen request → payments-api → database (production)
One representative slice of the HLD, at implementation detail. Letters on flows match the NetworkPolicy table. TLS / KMS badges show where encryption happens.
API endpoint: private only. API SG: 443 from admin SSM-bastion SG; no CI runner access.
Admission: Pod Security Admission (namespace labels) → Kyverno webhooks
(verifyImages + SBOM attestation, registry allowlist, no cluster-admin, limits)

Nothing else. No K8s RBAC bindings.

Node role: AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy + ECR pull-only. Nothing else.
